title: Guidance API entry
description: Schema for one guidance-api/<id>.json file. See guidance-api/README.md for the full rationale (why this is a separate API from component-api), this file is the machine-checkable version of that same schema.

id.description: Must match the id used for the same component in component-api exactly, this is the join key. Not a tag name: some entries (like toolbox) have no real custom element behind them at all.

dos.description: Things to do. May be empty. Not padded to hit a count, if only one real thing is worth saying, there's one entry.

donts.description: Things to avoid, ideally naming the concrete symptom of getting it wrong, not just "don't do X".

text.description: One sentence, citing something concrete and specific to this component's real implementation (a method, property, or lifecycle behavior), not generic UX advice.
